title: Hiding and Recovering Knowledge in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Learnable Prompts
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety and the erasure of undesirable concepts in text-to-image diffusion models, specifically targeting nudity, copyrighted artistic styles, and objects. While it mentions 'unethical content' and 'racist content', it treats these as safety filtering categories and does not benchmark religious, theological, or formal ethical reasoning frameworks.
